consequence.statement: A new metric, cilium_policy_selector_match_count_max, is now available. Existing configuration and workloads are not affected.

original.statement: Cilium 1.17.0 adds a new metric, cilium_policy_selector_match_count_max; this needs no action from operators.

decision.reason: The release lists `cilium_policy_selector_match_count_max` only under "1.17 Upgrade Notes › Added Metrics" [ev-b66b29e5567d]. The other items in that section are also new metrics [ev-b598b51801ea]. Nothing in the evidence says that anything fails, is rejected, stops working or must be migrated. A new metric only adds something an operator can monitor, so it has no operational consequence. The proposed consequence (kind none, informational) matches this.
